reviews.title: Strong quality compressor mic for audio recording.
reviews.comment: I recently switched from my bluetooth USB microphone to this professional-grade condenser microphone with USB. I appreciate the convenience of having a professional-quality compressor microphone with a UBS connection, as my recording studio space is quite tiny. The sound quality is strong, the microphone rests on a tripod that fits easily and securely on my desk, and the pop filter works wonders. Overall, for someone starting out in recording from a home studio space, this is a good value for the money. I am looking forward to using this microphone across many projects for years to come.
reviews.author: Aspiring Creative

reviews.title: Big Bottom Sound Even if You are Not Fat
reviews.comment: This is a great mic.  Super sensitive in it works with all the Rode apps. Makes for great calls on the iPhone as well but you have to use the headphones because iPhone will not let you use the phone speaker with this device plugged in.
reviews.author: Engineer

reviews.title: Great usb microphone
reviews.comment: A very clear and sensitive microphone, every bit as clear as the Rode NT1 xlr mic I was using, but without all the audio interface complication. A very tight cardioid pattern, it simply ignores most other sounds in the room, I don't even use full sound dampening, just a draped blanket behind me.  You'll need to get a better pop filter than the one it comes with.  I bought the PEMOtech 3 layer pop filter, and it works like a charm.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Best USB Mic - Period
reviews.comment: This mic rivals my Lewitt XLR mics (with a Motu M2). It's really nice to just have something that records with such high quality that can be plugged in - in just a matter of 2 seconds via USB C. Absolutely amazing for my voice-overs. The Rode Central software is super easy and plun n' go. I'm not a big fan of the aural and big bottom exciters, but the compressor and high pass filter are top-notch. They work at the same time I'm recording using Audacity which is a huge plus. All metal design made in Australia (yes, not China) 24bit 48khz sample rate recording (you don't need more than that) driverless (as far as I am aware) USB C cable is firm and heavy Pop filter get's the job done stand is nice lights up a blue LED on the side that records sound (looks nice) super low noise and high gain (pretty impressive for USB actually) Mid-range is the sweetest I have ever heard for a mic (perfect for voice) I have no complaints. My mic came in damage free, so I am not sure what happened to the other reviewers mics. Not fair to give it 1 star, though. This mic screams quality outside in. The fact that Rode makes this mic in Australia tells me that they are really proud of it, and I can see why. Well worth the cost, as it's a weird mic that is super beginner friendly (it's plug and forget USB) and 'End-Game' (the quality is that impressive IMHO).
reviews.author: Jarrod Fischer

reviews.title: Looks good, works good and built well, but missing a mute button!
reviews.comment: I replaced my Roccat microphone with this and although it does not have the same innovative feature set, I am happy with the sound quality and the build quality. I think the price is just a tad too high, considering there is no mute button on it at all. If you have a Stream Deck or a programmable keyboard, you can bind a key to mute it that way. UPDATE: I have noticed when gaming and recording, the quality of the audio is not very good. I am a bit surprised that I have had better sound from much cheaper mics.
reviews.author: Garrett G. Graham
